purpose: Teach: 相模原/小嶋/佐原/文京/原画/沢田/クイック/壇上

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「神奈川県相模原に親戚を訪ねよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad was saying, 'Let's go visit the relatives in Sagamihara, in Kanagawa.'
lines.style: Soft, unhurried opening. Gentle lift on the quoted words, warm and inviting toward the child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小嶋家のお祝いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I went with Daddy to the Kojima family's celebration!
lines.style: Small proud voice, a careful pause before starting, brightening on the final word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「千葉県佐原の小江戸を観光しよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad was saying, 'Let's go sightseeing in Sawara, in Chiba — the little old Edo town.'
lines.style: Melodic storytelling softness, a slight smile audible, pacing the quote like a small treat.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと東京の文京区にある後楽園行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I went with Daddy to Korakuen — it's in Bunkyo, in Tokyo!
lines.style: Quiet but eager, the place names recited carefully like he memorized them specially.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアニメの原画展に連れて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho-kun, I hear your dad's going to take you to an exhibit of original anime drawings.
lines.style: Gently conspiratorial, leaning in. Soft rising warmth, sharing good news like a secret.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと沢田研二の懐メロ聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, me and Daddy listened to old songs by Kenji Sawada!
lines.style: Delighted little report, slightly breathless, stumbling sweetly over the singer's name.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがクイックチャージ式のおもちゃを下さるわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad's going to give you one of those quick-charge toys.
lines.style: Bright, teasing lilt on the toy's name, watching for the child's reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「壇上に上がる勇気」を学んだよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, Daddy taught me about 'the courage to go up on stage'!
lines.style: Solemn little declaration, quoting the big phrase with great care, then a small satisfied breath.
